title: Distributed Predictive Flocking for a Swarm of Miniature Vibration-Driven Robots in a Confined Arena
abstract: arXiv:2610.35582v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Coordinating many miniature robots in a confined arena, with no leader, central planner, or global map, is a core challenge for swarm robotics. As the swarm grows denser, collision avoidance becomes the limiting factor, and the number of safely coexisting robots depends on the formulation of the inter-robot safety constraint. We present a distributed predictive flocking controller in which each robot solves its own nonlinear model predictive control (NMPC) problem, optimizing swarm cohesion and alignment costs, inter-robot and obstacle safety, and a task objective, while exchanging only predicted trajectories with local neighbors. Within this generalized controller architecture, solved in real time, we compare six barrier and control-barrier-function (CBF) safety formulations on a digital twin of an open-source vibration-driven bristlebot in a $0.64\,\mathrm{m^2}$ arena. translated_title: 封闭场地内微型振动驱动机器人集群的分布式预测群集控制
translated_abstract: 在没有领导者、中央规划器或全局地图的封闭场地内协调大量微型机器人，是集群机器人学的核心挑战。随着集群密度增大，避碰成为限制性因素，而能够安全共存的机器人数量取决于机器人间安全约束的构建方式。我们提出了一种分布式预测群集控制器，其中每个机器人求解各自的非线性模型预测控制（NMPC）问题，优化集群凝聚性、对齐代价、机器人间与障碍物安全性以及任务目标，同时仅与局部邻居交换预测轨迹。在这一可实时求解的通用控制器架构下，我们在0.64平方米场地内开源振动驱动鬃毛机器人的数字孪生体上，比较了六种障碍函数与控制障碍函数（CBF）安全约束构建方法。前瞻式离散时间CBF整体表现最佳（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出一种分布式预测群集控制器，使每个微型机器人在无领导者和中央规划的情况下通过求解各自的NMPC问题并与局部邻居交换预测轨迹实现集群协同，并系统比较了六种安全约束方法，发现前瞻式离散时间CBF在高密度受限场地中表现最佳。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a distributed predictive flocking controller in which each miniature robot solves its own NMPC problem and exchanges only predicted trajectories with local neighbors, and systematically compares six safety constraint formulations, showing that a look-ahead discrete-time CBF performs best in dense, confined arenas.
